propositions: A plan edited mid-review currently runs all remaining LLM passes and fails only at sign time, wasting billable computation after the edit
Checkpoint entries keyed by material fingerprint become orphaned when own material changes, yet the run continues using stale state
A cancel signal must distinguish own-material changes from unrelated ticket writes and relation snapshot drift to avoid false mid-run cancels (d70a regression)
The cancel mechanism must intercept the flow before coach/verify recovery paths that would emit sidecar writes and advance store revision
Two between-pass seams (plan_review_verify_inputs and plan_review_coach_inputs) provide attack points for a lightweight own-material probe without per-chunk polling or store-wide reads
The cancelled verdict must be unsigned INDETERMINATE that returns before attestation signing and sidecar emission, with CLI exit code 2
